omari: Planning a tiny 'stir-and-watch' tonight  under 90min recs + one-track stirring songs (<4m). go!
lina: 'A Film About Coffee' (~60m) is perfect. song: 'Nils Frahm - Hammers' (3:30 edit) :coffee:
ben: 'Kedi' is cozy, 76m, calming. stirring song: 'Holocene' (Bon Iver) or 'Sufjan - Mystery of Love' short edit.
kevin: if you want fiction short: 'Paterson' is quiet and poetic, 118m tho. for strict <90: 'The Guilty' (Danish) is ~85 and gripping while still intimate. song: 'Explosions in the Sky - Your Hand in Mine' edit ~3:50.
omari: love these. anyone have a tiny lo-fi playlist? just 30-40min of background.
lina: made one: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1tinykitchenlofi -> mellow piano, lo-fi beats, soft vocals.
watchbot: Added ['A Film About Coffee','Kedi','The Guilty'] to omari's Watchlist: https://internal.redwood/watchlists/omari-stir-watch
ben: poll idea: movie starts at 7:30? react with :thumbsup: for yes.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'm in.
